title: Slow-release formulation of PARP inhibitor for combination oncology therapy
snippet: Patent describes a matrix-controlled slow-release oral formulation of a PARP inhibitor intended to reduce peak plasma concentration and associated GI toxicity in combination chemotherapy regimens.

title: Slow-release oral formulation of metformin for improved gastrointestinal tolerability
snippet: Patent claims a slow-release oral metformin formulation using a polymer matrix designed to reduce gastrointestinal adverse events relative to immediate-release tablets.

title: Combination formulation of SGLT2 inhibitor and antihypertensive agent
snippet: Patent describes a fixed-dose combination tablet of an SGLT2 inhibitor and an antihypertensive agent for once-daily dosing in resistant hypertension.

title: Stable lyophilized formulation of a broad-spectrum antiviral compound
snippet: Patent covers a lyophilized formulation intended to extend shelf-stability of a broad-spectrum antiviral compound for field deployment.
